Install owe-lockfeed on Omarchy

Lock screen video feed module for the OWE wallpaper engine

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add owe-lockfeed
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.2.10-2:
    pacman -Qi owe-lockfeed

Open and use owe-lockfeed

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql owe-lockfeed

Frequently asked questions

How do I install owe-lockfeed on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add owe-lockfeed. The download is 32.5 KB and it takes 76.7 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is owe-lockfeed free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall owe-lockfeed?

Run omarchy pkg drop owe-lockfeed. It removes the package from your system.

What does owe-lockfeed depend on?

The package declares 1 dependency: qt6-declarative. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is owe-lockfeed in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as owe-lockfeed (version 0.2.10-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://github.com/omacom/owe.
